status: specified before the first application benchmark run
selection: validation only, refit selected model on train+validation; nine candidates per learned family
pooled_control: classical_selected chooses a conventional model family using validation only, pooling 45 regression or 27 classification candidates; physics-informed and Bayes controls remain separate
reporting: keep every configuration, warning, failed candidate and test prediction; do not drop unfavorable cells
paired_gain_rule: descriptive paired seed-bootstrap lower endpoint > 0; at least 8/10 positive seeds; not a multiple-comparison significance claim
claim_boundary: simulated application prototypes; no observed hardware speedup or production benefit
